target: forge.sh pr-state — the adapter comes from the URL, not the repo's kind: a github-kind repo still reads a recorded GitLab MR
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
export FORGE=github FORGE_URL=https://gitlab.example.test FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
fx_run kind; echo "kind=$FX_OUT"
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7; fx_show r
fx_reqs
fx_done
